rules: PRODUCTION_SPEC §1/§3/§9; flat LIGHT backgrounds; product cut out from Garmin newsroom stills; 1–3 words on screen; a detailed 2-D object in every shot; watermark below content; logo end card; audio LOCKED. Length 45–55 s, HARD CAP 58 s. Draw no Garmin logo (text names only). Do NOT use images from Garmin's dealer PDF. The dog never wears a device on screen (the feature only tags the dog). Activity values like 'Walk · 3.2 km' carry the label 'example'.
palette_for_this_video: paper main; sky for the update; mint for Run with Dog + SPEC; blush for THE CATCH
assets: assets_sources.md (A, B official Garmin newsroom images 2200×1450; C small inset only)
new_objects: dogBuddy (flat 2-D dog side view: trot cycle, head tilt, leash line, paw-print trail; reuse for any pet/dog-tech story) — add to render/kit/OBJECTS.md. Reuse: watchOutline, questionStamp, downloadBar, appTile, counter, arrowPointer, priceTag, bars, trackerPing, crossMark, calendar, scoreTable, speechBubble, pill.

scenes.anchor: Your Garmin can now log your dog's runs.
scenes.image: A (Forerunner 70/170 press image, 2200×1450): crop the two watches, cut out, centred 80% width, slow push-in
scenes.object: dogBuddy NEW: 2-D dog trots in beside the watch on a leash line from the strap, paw prints stamp across the bottom
scenes.note: frame 1 = poster A: watch + dog + 'DOG MODE' pill peeking

scenes.object: questionStamp '?' slams above the dog; dog tilts head

scenes.anchor: Garmin's newest watch update adds dog profiles.
scenes.object: downloadBar fills 0→100% 'Q4 2026 update'; appTile 'Dog profile' with dog face icon pops in (text 'Garmin Connect' as text only, no Garmin logo drawn)

scenes.anchor: You tag your dog on your walks and runs.
scenes.object: dogBuddy walks along a route line; a tag pill '+ dog' snaps onto the activity card 'Walk · 3.2 km' (label 'example')
counter rolls 0→9; 9 small appTiles light up one by one (dog, map, recovery, messenger, group ride, pin drop, coach, data field, locate)

scenes.image: A + B small, side by side
scenes.object: watchOutline x24 grid pops in row by row (generic, unbranded) with counter '24 models'; pill 'fēnix · Forerunner · Venu · Instinct'

scenes.anchor: There's even a Run with Dog mode, and dog badges!
scenes.object: watch screen text 'Run with Dog' (watchOutline screen), dogBuddy runs; badge medal with paw drops in with a shine

scenes.anchor: The cheapest watch on the list?
scenes.object: arrowPointer points at the white Forerunner; label 'Forerunner 70'

scenes.anchor: The Forerunner seventy, at two forty-nine.
scenes.object: priceTag swings in '$249.99'; small pill 'US · since May 2026'; calendar chip 'May 2026'

scenes.anchor: Here's the catch. It doesn't track the dog itself.
scenes.object: trackerPing on the dog + crossMark over it; pill 'no tracker on the dog'

scenes.anchor: It just tags your dog on your workout.
scenes.object: activity card with '+ dog' tag (same as shot 4), dog icon as a sticker on the card

scenes.anchor: And it'll take weeks to reach every watch.
scenes.object: calendar flips through weeks; downloadBar stalls at 40% then creeps; pill 'Garmin: over the coming weeks'

scenes.anchor: By our score? Fifty-eight out of a hundred. It's a spec.
scenes.object: scoreTable 12.5/25 · 12/20 · 8/15 · 7.5/15 · 8/15 · 10/10 → total counter '58/100'; k snaps upright

scenes.anchor: Grab it if your dog is your running buddy.
scenes.object: dogBuddy and a runner silhouette run side by side along a route line, paw prints + shoe prints

scenes.anchor: Would you tag your dog on every run?
scenes.object: questionStamp '?' + speechBubble '+ dog?'; logo end card 'SPEC SCORE 58'
